title: Aspire Breeze Replacement Pod
description: The Aspire Breeze 2 Replacement Pod is an essential accessory for Breeze 2 vape kit users, offering versatility and convenience for on-the-go vaping. With a 2ml e-liquid capacity and pre-fitted with a 0.6ohm Aspire U-Tech coil, this refillable pod is perfect for vapers seeking a smooth, flavourful mouth-to-lung (MTL) experience. Designed with practicality in mind, the Breeze 2 pod allows you to easily switch between e-liquid flavours without the hassle of cleaning or disassembly. Its push-button pod removal system ensures effortless replacement, while the detachable mouthpiece protector provides a hygienic solution for carrying spare pods. The pre-installed 0.6ohm U-Tech coil is equipped with an organic cotton wick, delivering pure, consistent flavour and a satisfying throat hit. When the coil wears out, simply replace it to save on waste and cost. Leak-resistant and easy to refill, the Breeze 2 Replacement Pod is a reliable and convenient solution for vapers looking to keep their Breeze 2 kit running smoothly. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
